title: The latest colorway of Reebok’s high-performing Engine …
text:
The latest colorway of Reebok’s high-performing Engine … Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS The latest colorway of Reebok’s high-performing Engine …
 HoopsHype Oct. 21, 2026, 7:12 p.m. ET Sportico: The latest colorway of Reebok’s high-performing Engine A Basketball Shoes has arrived. Inspired by Darius Acuff Jr.'s, the all-new player-exclusive red colorway features Acuff’s new signature logo on the tongue . “The Engine A was the shoe that brought me to the brand. The first time I wore these I knew where I wanted to be, so it makes sense to start my pro journey with a PE of what started it all. Stay tuned for Acuff 1.” - Darius Acuff Jr.
